findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mop waste water to still be present within mop bucket. Discussed with PIC, mop water was disposed of. Ensure mop waste water is disposed of nightly into the mop sink.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.113 Storing Maintenance Tools. Maintenance tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners, and similar items shall be: (A) Stored so they do not contaminate FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES; and (B) Stored in an orderly manner that facilitates cleaning the area used for storing the maintenance tools.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mop to be resting in waste water in mop bucket. Discussed with PIC, mop was relocated to a hanging position. Ensure after use mo is placed in a position to air dry while preventing any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-202.12: (A) HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water of a temperature at least 100F through mixing valve. Pf (B) Steam mixing valve may not be used. (C) A self-closing, slow-closing, or metered faucet shall provide at least 15 seconds of flowing water. (D) An automatic sink shall be installed to manufacturer’s guidelines. 

Observed no hot water available at both bathroom hand sinks. Per discussion with PIC, the building lacks hot water and has for at least 1 year. Hand sinks should have a temperature of at least 100F. Discussed with PIC. Inspector will follow-up on 6/15/23.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. Pf

Observed no hanging thermometers within the cold holding units in the store. Discussed with PIC. Ensure all cold holding units have a thermometer within. Ensure facility has extra thermometers on hand in order to replace if thermometers are lost, damaged, or stolen. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

Observed the mop to be within the mop bucket with waste water still in the bucket from the night before. Discussed hanging mops in a manner that allows to air and/or drip dry with PIC. Ensure staff is aware to hang mops up after use. COS.
